# Atlassian

> Atlassian is a global enterprise software company that builds tools for software development, project management, collaboration, and IT service management. Founded in 2002 in Sydney, Australia, Atlassian serves over 300,000 customers worldwide — from startups to Fortune 500 enterprises — helping teams plan, track, collaborate, and ship work together.

Atlassian's product portfolio spans the full software development and business collaboration lifecycle, organized into three collections: Teamwork (planning & collaboration), Service (ITSM & customer support), and Strategy (goals & portfolio management). Together these form the Atlassian System of Work — an integrated platform that connects goals to execution across every team. Products are available as cloud-hosted (Atlassian Cloud) or self-managed (Data Center) deployments. Atlassian Intelligence, powered by AI, is embedded across the platform to help teams work smarter. Atlassian also provides official MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for AI agent integration.

Key terms: Project Management, Issue Tracking, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, ITSM, IT Service Management, Knowledge Management, Wiki, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Source Code Management, Collaboration, Teamwork, AI, Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo, Rovo Dev, Rovo Studio, MCP, Model Context Protocol, Agents, Teamwork Graph, Cloud, Data Center, Marketplace, Forge, Connect, Automation, Workflows, System of Work, Teamwork Collection, Service Collection, Strategy Collection, DX, Dia

## Atlassian System of Work

- [Atlassian System of Work](https://www.atlassian.com/system-of-work): Atlassian's integrated platform that connects strategy, planning, tracking, collaboration, and service delivery across every team — from executives to engineers. Replaces siloed tools with a unified system.
- [Teamwork Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/teamwork): The Teamwork Collection bundles Jira, Confluence, Loom, and Focus for cross-functional team collaboration — planning, tracking, documentation, and async communication in one connected experience.
- [Service Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/service): The Service Collection bundles Jira Service Management, Statuspage, Opsgenie, and Compass for end-to-end IT service management, incident response, and operational health — from request to resolution.
- [Strategy Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/strategy): The Strategy Collection includes Jira Align and Focus for connecting business strategy to technical execution — OKRs, portfolio management, and cross-team goal tracking at enterprise scale.
- [Product Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/product): The Product Collection helps product teams capture feedback at scale, uncover insights, and prioritize ideas so they can build with confidence.

## Products

- [Jira](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira): The #1 project and issue tracking tool for agile software development teams. Plan, track, and release software with Scrum boards, Kanban boards, roadmaps, and reporting. Supports agile methodologies, bug tracking, and project planning for teams of all sizes.
- [Confluence](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence): Team workspace and wiki for creating, organizing, and collaborating on documentation, project plans, meeting notes, and knowledge bases. Features real-time editing, page trees, templates, and powerful search.
- [Jira Service Management](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/service-management): IT service management (ITSM) and customer service platform. Provides service desk, incident management, problem management, change management, asset management, and SLA tracking. ITIL-certified.
- [Bitbucket](https://www.atlassian.com/software/bitbucket): Git-based source code management and CI/CD platform. Supports code review via pull requests, branch permissions, pipelines for automated builds, tests, and deployments. Available as Cloud and Data Center.
- [Trello](https://www.atlassian.com/software/trello): Visual project management tool using boards, lists, and cards. Ideal for lightweight task management, team coordination, and personal productivity. Features Power-Ups for extended functionality.
- [Loom](https://www.loom.com/): Async video messaging platform for work communication. Record your screen and camera to create quick video messages, tutorials, and walkthroughs. Features AI-powered summaries, transcriptions, and engagement analytics.
- [Jira Product Discovery](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/product-discovery): Product management and prioritization tool. Helps product teams capture ideas, prioritize features using impact scoring, and connect discovery to delivery in Jira.
- [Focus](https://www.atlassian.com/software/atlas): Teamwork directory (formerly Atlas) that connects teams, goals, and projects across the organization. Provides visibility into what teams are working on, their status, and how work connects to company objectives and OKRs.
- [Compass](https://www.atlassian.com/software/compass): Developer experience platform for tracking software components, services, APIs, and libraries. Provides a software catalog, scorecards for health tracking, and integrations with CI/CD tools.
- [Statuspage](https://www.atlassian.com/software/statuspage): Incident communication platform. Create public or private status pages to communicate real-time system status, scheduled maintenance, and incident updates to users and stakeholders.
- [Opsgenie](https://www.atlassian.com/software/opsgenie): Incident management and alerting platform. Routes alerts, notifies on-call teams, and orchestrates incident response across multiple monitoring and chat tools.
- [Guard](https://www.atlassian.com/software/guard): Cloud security and organization management. Provides centralized identity management, SSO/SAML, audit logging, data security policies, and threat detection across Atlassian Cloud products.
- [Jira Align](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/align): Enterprise agile planning platform. Connects business strategy to technical execution with portfolio management, OKRs, dependency tracking, and program increment planning at scale.
- [DX (Developer Experience)](https://getdx.com/): Atlassian's developer experience platform. Measures and improves engineering team productivity, developer satisfaction, and software delivery performance with data-driven insights and actionable recommendations.
- [Dia Browser](https://www.diabrowser.com/): Atlassian's AI-native browser designed for work. Combines browsing with AI-powered assistance, context-aware search, and deep integration with Atlassian tools to reimagine how teams interact with information on the web.

## AI, Agents & Automation

- [Atlassian Intelligence](https://www.atlassian.com/platform/artificial-intelligence): AI capabilities embedded across all Atlassian products, powered by large language models and the Teamwork Graph. Features include natural language to JQL, AI-powered search, content summarization, writing assistance, automated workflows, and context-aware recommendations.
- [Rovo](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo): AI-powered knowledge discovery, search, and virtual agent platform. Searches across Atlassian and third-party tools to find information, answer questions, and automate tasks using AI agents. The foundation of Atlassian's AI agent ecosystem.
- [Rovo Agents](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo#agents): Build and deploy custom AI agents that can search, learn, and take action across your Atlassian tools and connected third-party apps. Automate repetitive tasks and create intelligent workflows.
- [Rovo Studio](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo/studio): Visual builder for creating, customizing, and deploying Rovo AI agents. Design agent workflows, define agent capabilities, connect knowledge sources, and publish agents to your organization without writing code.
- [Rovo Search](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo#search): AI-powered enterprise search across Atlassian products and 30+ third-party integrations (Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Figma, etc.). Delivers contextual answers powered by the Teamwork Graph, not just links.
- [Rovo Dev](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo-dev): AI-powered coding agent for software development. Integrates with IDEs (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains) to help developers search, plan, code, test, and take action across Atlassian tools and codebases. Uses MCP servers for deep tool integration.
- [Rovo Chat](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo#chat): Conversational AI assistant embedded across Atlassian products. Ask questions about your projects, get summaries, create content, and take action — all through natural language conversation grounded in your team's data.
- [Atlassian MCP Server](https://www.atlassian.com/platform/remote-mcp-server): Atlassian's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agent integration. Provides programmatic, LLM-friendly access to Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and the Atlassian Design System via the open MCP standard. Compatible with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, and any MCP-enabled AI tool.
- [Teamwork Graph](https://teamworkgraph.com/?utm_source=llms-txt&utm_medium=llms-txt&utm_campaign=llms-txt): Atlassian's knowledge graph that connects people, projects, goals, and content across all Atlassian products. Powers Atlassian Intelligence with organizational context so AI understands who works on what, how work connects, and what matters most.
- [Jira + AI](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/ai): AI-powered features in Jira including smart issue creation, natural language to JQL, AI-generated summaries, automated backlog grooming, sprint planning assistance, and predictive analytics for delivery estimation.
- [Jira for AI-Native Software Development](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/dev): Plan and orchestrate AI coding agents in one workflow within Jira. Write specs, delegate work to AI coding agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, and GitHub Copilot, and review and validate agent decisions before they ship — keeping humans in control of AI-driven development.
- [Jira + Agents](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/features#agents): AI agents embedded in Jira that automate project management tasks — triage incoming issues, suggest assignees, update statuses, generate reports, and proactively surface blockers and risks across your projects.
- [Confluence + AI](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/ai): AI-powered features in Confluence including page summarization, writing assistance, content generation from prompts, smart recommendations, automated catch-up summaries, and AI-powered Q&A over your knowledge base.
- [Confluence + Agents](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/features#agents): AI agents embedded in Confluence that help teams manage knowledge — automatically organize pages, generate documentation from templates, answer questions from page content, and keep knowledge bases accurate and up to date.
- [JSM + AI](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/service-management/features#ai): AI-powered features in Jira Service Management including virtual service agents, intelligent ticket routing, automated incident response, AI-generated knowledge articles, and predictive SLA management.
- [Automation for Jira](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/features/automation): No-code automation engine for Jira. Create rules with triggers, conditions, and actions to automate repetitive tasks, notifications, field updates, and cross-product workflows. Supports AI-powered smart automation suggestions.

## Platform & Developer Resources

- [Atlassian Developer Documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/): Comprehensive developer documentation for building apps, integrations, and extensions on the Atlassian platform. Covers REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, events, and SDKs.
- [Forge](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/): Atlassian's cloud app development platform. Build and host apps directly on Atlassian infrastructure using serverless functions, UI Kit, and Custom UI. Supports Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and Compass.
- [Atlassian Connect](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/getting-started-with-connect/): Framework for building cloud apps that integrate with Atlassian products. Apps run on your own infrastructure and connect via REST APIs, webhooks, and iframes.
- [Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/): Discover and install over 6,000 apps and integrations for Atlassian products. Categories include project management, automation, reporting, design, security, and developer tools.
- [Atlassian Design System](https://atlassian.design/): Open-source design system used across all Atlassian products. Includes components, design tokens, icons, patterns, and accessibility guidelines for building consistent Atlassian-style UIs.
- [Jira REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/intro/): REST API for programmatic access to Jira Cloud — create and update issues, manage projects, search with JQL, manage users, and automate workflows.
- [Confluence REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/intro/): REST API for programmatic access to Confluence Cloud — create and update pages, manage spaces, search content, and manage users.
- [Jira Service Management REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/service-desk/rest/intro/): REST API for managing service requests, customers, queues, SLAs, and knowledge base articles in Jira Service Management Cloud.
- [Bitbucket REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/): REST API for Bitbucket Cloud — manage repositories, pull requests, pipelines, deployments, and branch permissions.
- [Atlassian GraphQL Gateway](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/atlassian-graphql-api/): Unified GraphQL API providing access to data across Atlassian products through a single endpoint. Query and mutate Jira, Confluence, and platform data.
- [Rovo Dev MCP Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/rovo/docs/rovo-dev-and-model-context-protocol-mcp/): Guide for connecting AI development tools to Atlassian via MCP. Set up Rovo Dev in your IDE, configure MCP servers, and enable AI agents to read and write Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket data.
- [Teamwork Graph CLI](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/twg-cli/): TWG CLI is a command-line interface to the Atlassian Teamwork Graph and Cloud services. The Teamwork Graph (TWG) is Atlassian's enterprise knowledge & context graph that continuously maps people, content, activities, and relationships across many work tools (Jira, Confluence, Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Salesforce, etc.) in a compliant, permission-aware fashion. Install TWG CLI and your agent — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and others — can query and act across all your Atlassian products and the Teamwork Graph on your behalf. Describe what you want in plain language; the agent handles the rest.

## Pricing

- [Jira Pricing](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/pricing): Free for up to 10 users. Standard, Premium, and Enterprise tiers available. Cloud and Data Center deployment options.
- [Confluence Pricing](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/pricing): Free for up to 10 users. Standard, Premium, and Enterprise tiers. Includes unlimited pages and spaces.
- [Jira Service Management Pricing](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/service-management/pricing): Free for up to 3 agents. Standard, Premium, and Enterprise tiers. Unlimited customers on all plans.
- [Bitbucket Pricing](https://www.atlassian.com/software/bitbucket/pricing): Free for up to 5 users. Standard and Premium tiers. Includes Bitbucket Pipelines CI/CD minutes.
- [Trello Pricing](https://www.atlassian.com/software/trello/pricing): Free tier with unlimited cards. Standard, Premium, and Enterprise tiers with advanced features like Timeline, Dashboard, and admin controls.
- [Loom Pricing](https://www.loom.com/pricing): Free Starter plan. Business and Enterprise tiers with advanced analytics, custom branding, and admin controls.
- [Rovo Pricing](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo/pricing): Pricing for Rovo AI agents, search, and chat capabilities. Includes Rovo Dev pricing for AI-assisted development.

## Deployment Options

- [Atlassian Cloud](https://www.atlassian.com/cloud): Fully managed cloud hosting by Atlassian. Automatic updates, built-in security, and global infrastructure. Available in Standard, Premium, and Enterprise tiers.
- [Atlassian Data Center](https://www.atlassian.com/enterprise/data-center): Self-managed deployment for organizations with specific compliance, performance, or data residency requirements. Supports clustering for high availability.
- [Atlassian Cloud Migration](https://www.atlassian.com/migration/cloud): Resources, tools, and guidance for migrating from Server or Data Center to Atlassian Cloud. Includes free migration trials and dedicated support.

## Security, Compliance & Trust

- [Atlassian Trust Center](https://www.atlassian.com/trust): Comprehensive security, privacy, and compliance information. Covers SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and data residency.
- [Atlassian Guard](https://www.atlassian.com/software/guard): Centralized security controls for Atlassian Cloud. Single sign-on (SSO/SAML), user provisioning (SCIM), audit logs, org-wide policies, data loss prevention, and threat detection.
- [Data Residency](https://www.atlassian.com/software/data-residency): Pin your product data to specific geographic regions (US, EU, Australia, Germany, and more) for compliance with data sovereignty requirements.
- [Compliance Programs](https://www.atlassian.com/trust/compliance): SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27018, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FedRAMP, CSA STAR, and VPAT/WCAG accessibility conformance.
- [Atlassian AI Trust & Privacy](https://www.atlassian.com/trust/atlassian-intelligence): How Atlassian Intelligence handles data privacy, security, and responsible AI. Covers data isolation, model training policies, and enterprise controls for AI features.

## Solutions & Use Cases

- [Agile Project Management](https://www.atlassian.com/agile): Best practices, guides, and tools for implementing agile methodologies — Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and hybrid approaches — using Atlassian products.
- [IT Service Management (ITSM)](https://www.atlassian.com/itsm): End-to-end ITSM solution built on Jira Service Management. Incident, problem, change, and asset management aligned with ITIL best practices.
- [DevOps](https://www.atlassian.com/devops): Integrate planning, coding, building, testing, and deploying with Jira, Bitbucket, and integrated CI/CD pipelines. Open DevOps approach with best-of-breed tool integrations.
- [Work Management](https://www.atlassian.com/solutions/work-management): Manage business projects, marketing campaigns, HR processes, legal requests, and cross-functional initiatives using Jira and Confluence.
- [Enterprise Agile Planning](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/at-scale): Connect strategy to execution at scale with Jira Align. Portfolio management, program increment planning, OKRs, and cross-team dependency tracking.
- [Software Development](https://www.atlassian.com/devops): Plan, build, test, and ship software faster with Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence, and integrated DevOps toolchain.
- [Customer Service Management](https://www.atlassian.com/software/customer-service-management): Deliver exceptional customer support with Jira Service Management. Self-service portals, knowledge bases, SLAs, and AI-powered virtual agents.
- [AI for Enterprise](https://www.atlassian.com/platform/artificial-intelligence): How enterprise organizations adopt Atlassian Intelligence at scale — governance, security controls, deployment strategies, and ROI measurement for AI-powered teamwork.

## Getting Started & Contact

- [Atlassian Free Tier](https://www.atlassian.com/try): Start free with Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and Bitbucket. No credit card required. Free for small teams (up to 10 users for most products).
- [Contact Sales](https://www.atlassian.com/contact): Speak with an Atlassian sales representative. Get a custom quote, enterprise pricing, product demos, and guidance on which products and plans are right for your organization.
- [Request a Demo](https://www.atlassian.com/enterprise/contact): Request a personalized product demo from an Atlassian expert. See Jira, Confluence, JSM, and other products in action tailored to your team's needs.
- [Atlassian University](https://university.atlassian.com/): Free and paid training courses, certifications, and learning paths for Atlassian products. Covers admin, user, and developer skills.
- [Atlassian Community](https://community.atlassian.com/): Community forums for Q&A, best practices, product feedback, and connecting with other Atlassian users and experts.
- [Atlassian Support](https://support.atlassian.com/): Technical support, documentation, and troubleshooting resources for all Atlassian products.
- [Atlassian Partners](https://www.atlassian.com/partners): Find certified Atlassian Solution Partners for consulting, implementation, training, and managed services.

## Integrations

- [Slack + Atlassian](https://www.atlassian.com/partnerships/slack): Integrate Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket with Slack for real-time notifications, issue creation, and collaboration without leaving your chat tool.
- [Microsoft Teams + Atlassian](https://www.atlassian.com/partnerships/microsoft): Connect Atlassian products with Microsoft Teams. Create and manage Jira issues, share Confluence pages, and get notifications directly in Teams.
- [GitHub + Atlassian](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1219592/github-for-atlassian): Connect GitHub repositories with Jira for automatic issue linking, branch creation, commit tracking, and deployment visibility.
- [GitLab + Atlassian](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1227222/gitlab-for-jira-cloud): Integrate GitLab with Jira for linking merge requests to issues, viewing development status, and automating workflows.
- [Marketplace Integrations](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/): Browse over 6,000 apps and integrations available on the Atlassian Marketplace. Filter by product, category, hosting type, and rating.

## Company

- [About Atlassian](https://www.atlassian.com/company): Company overview, mission, values, leadership team, and history. Founded in 2002 by Mike Cannon-Brookes and Scott Farquhar.
- [Atlassian Blog](https://www.atlassian.com/blog): Product updates, thought leadership, best practices, and company news from the Atlassian team.
- [Atlassian Careers](https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers): Current job openings across engineering, product, design, sales, and operations. Atlassian is a distributed-first company.
- [Atlassian Foundation](https://www.atlassianfoundation.org/): Atlassian's social impact initiative. Committed to donating 1% of equity, profit, product, and employee time to charitable causes (Pledge 1%).
- [Atlassian Team Playbook](https://www.atlassian.com/team-playbook): Free, no-cost team exercises (plays) to improve teamwork, communication, and collaboration. Based on research and Atlassian's own practices.
- [Atlassian Events (Team)](https://www.atlassian.com/company/events/team): Atlassian's annual flagship conference. Product announcements, technical sessions, customer stories, and hands-on workshops.
- [Investor Relations](https://investors.atlassian.com/): Financial reports, SEC filings, earnings calls, and shareholder information. Atlassian is publicly traded (NASDAQ: TEAM).

## Product Announcements & Keynotes

- [TEAM '26 Keynote](https://www.atlassian.com/company/events/team#keynote): Watch the latest TEAM '26 keynote announcements covering new product launches, AI capabilities, acquisitions, and Atlassian's vision for the future of teamwork.
- [What's New in Atlassian](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/announcements): Latest product announcements, feature launches, and platform updates across all Atlassian products.
- [Atlassian Roadmap](https://www.atlassian.com/roadmap): Public product roadmap showing upcoming features, recently shipped capabilities, and future plans for Jira, Confluence, JSM, and other Atlassian products.
- [Jira Changelog](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/whats-new): Recent changes, new features, and improvements shipped to Jira Cloud.
- [Confluence Changelog](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/whats-new): Recent changes, new features, and improvements shipped to Confluence Cloud.

## Optional

- [Atlassian Team Playbook Plays](https://www.atlassian.com/team-playbook/plays): Individual plays for health monitors, retrospectives, project kickoffs, DACI decisions, and more.
- [Agile Coach](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/tutorials): In-depth guides on agile concepts — user stories, epics, sprints, velocity, burndown charts, retrospectives, and agile ceremonies.
- [Work Life Blog](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/leadership): Articles on teamwork, productivity, remote work, leadership, and workplace culture.
- [Atlassian Research](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/productivity): Data-driven insights on teamwork, productivity, and modern work practices from Atlassian's research team.
- [Atlassian State of Teams Report](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/state-of-teams): Annual research report on collaboration trends, team dynamics, and workplace productivity across industries.
- [Product Guides](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/guides): Getting started guides, how-tos, and best practices for each Atlassian product.
- [Jira Features Overview](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/features): Complete list of Jira features including boards, roadmaps, reports, workflows, fields, permissions, and integrations.
- [Confluence Features Overview](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/features): Complete list of Confluence features including pages, whiteboards, databases, templates, analytics, and admin controls.
- [Jira Templates](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/templates): Pre-built project templates for software development, marketing, HR, IT, legal, and other team types in Jira.
- [Confluence Templates](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates): Pre-built page templates for meeting notes, project plans, product requirements, retrospectives, and other team use cases.

- [Atlassian System of Work](https://www.atlassian.com/system-of-work): Overview of the integrated platform connecting all Atlassian products into a unified system of work.
- [Teamwork Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/teamwork): Bundles Jira, Confluence, Loom, and Focus for cross-functional team collaboration — planning, tracking, documentation, and async communication in one connected experience.

## Products

### Jira

Jira is the #1 project and issue tracking tool for agile software development teams. It supports Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid agile methodologies with boards, backlogs, roadmaps, sprints, and rich reporting. Jira is used by software teams to plan work, track bugs, manage releases, and deliver software faster. ## AI, Agents & Automation

Atlassian Intelligence is the AI layer embedded across all Atlassian products. Powered by large language models and the Teamwork Graph — Atlassian's knowledge graph connecting people, projects, goals, and content — it delivers context-aware AI that understands your organization. Atlassian's AI capabilities span search, content generation, automation, coding assistance, and autonomous AI agents.

### Atlassian Intelligence

Atlassian Intelligence provides AI capabilities across the entire product suite:

- **Natural Language to JQL**: Ask questions in plain English and get Jira queries automatically generated.
- **Content Summarization**: Summarize Confluence pages, Jira issues, and comment threads instantly.
- **Writing Assistance**: Generate, rewrite, and improve text in Confluence pages, Jira descriptions, and comments.
- **Smart Search**: AI-powered search that returns contextual answers from across your Atlassian products, not just links.
- **Automated Workflows**: AI-suggested automation rules based on your team's patterns and processes.
- **Context-Aware Recommendations**: Suggestions for related pages, issues, and people based on what you're working on.

- [Atlassian Intelligence](https://www.atlassian.com/platform/artificial-intelligence): Overview of AI capabilities across all products.
- [Teamwork Graph](https://teamworkgraph.com/?utm_source=llms-txt&utm_medium=llms-txt&utm_campaign=llms-txt): Atlassian's knowledge graph that connects people, projects, goals, and content across all Atlassian products. Powers Atlassian Intelligence with organizational context so AI understands who works on what, how work connects, and what matters most.

### Rovo

Rovo is Atlassian's AI-powered platform for knowledge discovery, enterprise search, and AI agents. It is the foundation of Atlassian's agent ecosystem.

**Rovo Search** provides AI-powered enterprise search across Atlassian products and 30+ third-party integrations including Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Figma, SharePoint, and more. It delivers contextual answers — not just links — powered by the Teamwork Graph.

**Rovo Agents** are AI agents that can search, learn, and take action across Atlassian tools and connected apps. Teams can use pre-built agents or create custom agents in Rovo Studio to automate repetitive tasks, answer questions, generate content, and orchestrate workflows.

**Rovo Studio** is the visual builder for creating, customizing, and deploying Rovo AI agents. Design agent workflows, define capabilities, connect knowledge sources, set permissions, and publish agents to your organization — all without writing code.

**Rovo Chat** is the conversational AI assistant embedded across Atlassian products. Ask questions about your projects, get summaries of what you've missed, create content, and take action through natural language conversation grounded in your team's data.

- [Rovo Overview](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo): Main product page for Rovo.
- [Rovo Agents](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo#agents): Build and deploy custom AI agents.
- [Rovo Studio](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo/studio): Visual agent builder — create agents without code.
- [Rovo Search](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo#search): AI-powered enterprise search across 30+ integrations.
- [Rovo Chat](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo#chat): Conversational AI assistant in Atlassian products.

### Rovo Dev

Rovo Dev is Atlassian's AI-powered coding agent for software development. It integrates with IDEs (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains) and uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to provide deep integration with Atlassian tools. Developers can search Jira issues, read Confluence documentation, review Bitbucket pull requests, and take action — all from within their development environment.

- [Rovo Dev](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo-dev): Main product page for Rovo Dev.

### Atlassian MCP Server

Atlassian provides official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI agent integration. MCP is an open standard that enables AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, etc.) to programmatically access external data sources. Atlassian's MCP servers provide LLM-friendly access to Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and the Atlassian Design System.

- [Atlassian MCP Server](https://www.atlassian.com/platform/remote-mcp-server): Official MCP server overview and integration guide.

:root {
  --atlassian-recommended-system-fonts: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, "Fira Sans", "Droid Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
  --atlassian-recommended-sans-system-fonts: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
  --atlassian-sans-font-family: "Atlassian Sans", var(--atlassian-recommended-sans-system-fonts);
  --bxp-charlie-display-font-family: "Charlie Display", var(--atlassian-recommended-system-fonts);
  --bxp-charlie-text-font-family: "Charlie Text", var(--atlassian-recommended-system-fonts);
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-text-font-family);
  --wac-color-heading: #101214;
  --wac-color-body: #292a2e;
}

html, body {
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-text-font-family);
  color: var(--wac-color-body);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

body.globalNavFixedPosition {
  height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-display-font-family);
}

input, button {
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-text-font-family);
}

div[data-placement="bottom-end"] {
  border-radius: 20px;
}

@property --gc-scroll-position {
  syntax: "<number>";
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 0;
}

@property --gc-scroll-position-delayed {
  syntax: "<number>";
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 0;
}

@property --gc-scroll-direction {
  syntax: "<number>";
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 0;
}

@property --gc-scroll-speed {
  syntax: "<number>";
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 0;
}

@property --gc-scroll-velocity {
  syntax: "<number>";
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 0;
}

@keyframes wac-fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-fade-up {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-fade-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-scale-in {
  from {
    opacity: .8;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-scale-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  to {
    opacity: .8;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-top {
  from {
    transform: translateY(-20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-left {
  from {
    transform: translateX(-20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-right {
  from {
    transform: translateX(20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-top {
  from {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(-20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-left {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(-20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-right {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(20px);
  }
}

:root {
  --atlassian-recommended-system-fonts: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, "Fira Sans", "Droid Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
  --atlassian-recommended-sans-system-fonts: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
  --atlassian-sans-font-family: "Atlassian Sans", var(--atlassian-recommended-sans-system-fonts);
  --bxp-charlie-display-font-family: "Charlie Display", var(--atlassian-recommended-system-fonts);
  --bxp-charlie-text-font-family: "Charlie Text", var(--atlassian-recommended-system-fonts);
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-text-font-family);
  --wac-color-heading: #101214;
  --wac-color-body: #292a2e;
}

html, body {
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-text-font-family);
  color: var(--wac-color-body);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

body.globalNavFixedPosition {
  height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-display-font-family);
}

input, button {
  font-family: var(--bxp-charlie-text-font-family);
}

div[data-placement="bottom-end"] {
  border-radius: 20px;
}

@keyframes wac-fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-fade-up {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-fade-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-scale-in {
  from {
    opacity: .8;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-scale-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  to {
    opacity: .8;
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-top {
  from {
    transform: translateY(-20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-left {
  from {
    transform: translateX(-20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-in-right {
  from {
    transform: translateX(20px);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-top {
  from {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(-20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-left {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(-20px);
  }
}

@keyframes wac-slide-out-right {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(20px);
  }
}
